body.primary_source: PKCS#12 (RFC 7292) Appendix B -- the key/IV derivation; mirrored from the pinned authority's own test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppbe_pkcs12.txt (Title = `PKCS12 tests`)

provenance.note: One value per stanza: `pkcs12.NN` is `Key`, the lowercase hex of `PKCS12_key_gen_uni`'s `key_len`-byte output for the stanza's own Password/Salt/id/iter/MD. The inputs are re-read from forensics/authorities/src/openssl-3.6.4/test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppbe_pkcs12.txt by the probe, so they are not typed twice. Excluded: forensics/authorities/src/openssl-3.6.4/test/recipes/30-test_evp_data/evppbe_pkcs12.txt's sibling `evppbe_pbkdf2.txt` (PBE = pbkdf2, a different unit) and the `80-test_pkcs12.t` container recipe (PKCS7/X509, not this unit). All six `PBE = pkcs12` stanzas are mirrored.
